Business Requirements Description:
This system is designed to manage customer information, repair tasks, orders, parts, suppliers, and technicians for an auto repair service. The core functionalities include:
The system stores basic customer information, including a unique customer ID, name, and phone number.
The system maintains basic information for each technician, including a unique technician ID, name, and contact address.
The system stores information about different car models, each with a unique model ID and name.
Each repair task is recorded with a unique task ID, related car model ID, task status (e.g., Pending, In Progress, Completed), customer ID, technician ID, task creation date, and completion date.
Each repair task corresponds to an order, and the system records the order ID, related task ID, order creation date, and delivery status.
The system maintains basic information about suppliers, including a unique supplier ID and name.
The system tracks parts by their unique part ID, serial number, description, price, supplier ID, and inventory quantity.
The system manages the relationship between parts and orders, tracking the quantity of parts required for each order and the parts used in each repair task.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0376

CREATE TABLE customers (
  customer_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  phone_number VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE technicians (
  technician_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  contact_address VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (technician_id)
);

CREATE TABLE car_models (
  model_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (model_id)
);

CREATE TABLE repair_tasks (
  task_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  model_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  technician_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  task_creation_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  completion_date DATETIME,
  PRIMARY KEY (task_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models (model_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (customer_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (technician_id) REFERENCES technicians (technician_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  task_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  order_creation_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  delivery_status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES repair_tasks (task_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE suppliers (
  supplier_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id)
);

CREATE TABLE parts (
  part_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  serial_number VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  supplier_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  inventory_quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (part_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (supplier_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE order_parts (
  order_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  part_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, part_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (part_id) REFERENCES parts (part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE repair_task_parts (
  task_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  part_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (task_id, part_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES repair_tasks (task_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (part_id) REFERENCES parts (part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
